title: Task
description: Canonical contract specification for task items in todolist core.

id.description: Unique deterministic task identifier (e.g., TASK-101, WORK-204).

title.description: Concise human-readable title of the task.

status.description: Current lifecycle status in the Newport-aligned task pipeline.

depth.description: Cognitive depth classification according to Cal Newport's Deep Work methodology.

waiting_on.description: Description or reference of what/who is blocking this task when status is 'waiting'.

time_estimate_minutes.description: Estimated duration in minutes, constrained to 15-minute time-blocking increments.

created_at.description: Creation date in ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format.

due.description: Optional deadline in ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format.

completed_at.description: Optional completion date in ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format.

tags.description: List of categorical labels and contextual tags.
